name: Estimated liquidation proxy: Binance perp vs Coinbase spot volume spike
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Volume difference between Binance perp and Coinbase spot, WMA(8), SuperSmoother
entry_long: premium series = Binance perp volume - Coinbase spot volume on down (close<=open) bars, 0 on up bars (estimated liquidation volume). Diff-mode default: long when premium crosses above 2,000,000 AND close > WMA(480).
entry_short: Optional short on cross under premiumValue when onlyLong=false.
exit: strategy.exit: take profit +1% and stop -1% from average entry price.
filters: close > WMA(4*24*5=480 bars); optional date range
implementation_notes: Liquidations are estimated from a volume difference; threshold 2,000,000 is in contract/units of the chosen symbol feed.
